text:
maria: Quick brainstorm — want a tighter benchmark narrative for the upcoming launch. Thinking of framing it as 'Speed vs. Price' (avoid the jargon-y 'latency-cost' phrase). Webinar audience = product/platform engineers at mid-market + platform leads. Need two clear charts, one short explainer, and routing CTAs. Anyone up for sketching slides?

alex: Love the framing. For charts: (A) throughput (tokens/sec) on x vs. cost per 1k tokens on y, (B) tail latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) vs effective $/request. Make B a small-multiples view by model family. Use log scale for cost axis.

sam: For non-engineer attendees, translate 'cost per 1k tokens' to 'cost per completed query' as an alternate label. Add a 1-line "how to read it" callout under each chart so PMs get it instantly.

jamal: Models to include: rw-compact-8q, rw-standard-16, open-v fast and open-v high-quality. Also include a quantized vs fp16 variant for each so we show tradeoffs. Callout: we should highlight the routing fallback — i.e., how you can route to cheaper variant when load spikes.

olivia: Inbound routing: map two funnels. SMB -> webinar sign-up -> self-serve quickstart -> usage sample + cost calc. Enterprise -> webinar sign-up -> demo request -> dedicated capacity pricing deck. We'll add toggles on landing page for "I care about latency" vs "I care about price" and route content accordingly.

benchbot: automated note: attached latest perf dump: https://internal/redwood/bench/2795_dump.csv  (contains tokens/sec, mean/p95/p99 latencies, cost-per-1k estimation for models above).

maria: Nice. Can we get 2 mock slide comps + 1 short explainer paragraph by Tue EOD? @alex @olivia can you own slides? @sam you own explainer copy. Jamal — can you produce the data slices we'll plot?

alex: Yep I can take slides. Plan: slide 1 = hero chart (speed vs price) with 3 model dots + callouts. slide 2 = small multiples (p50/p95/p99) + routing overlay. I'll add a short GIF showing a request switching routes when cost/latency threshold flips.

sam: Will write 2 headline variants and a one-paragraph explainer. Draft headlines: A) "Optimize for speed and spend" B) "Get the latency you want at the price you need" — leaning A. Will include a 1-sentence "how to read" + 1-line methodology note.

olivia: For landing CTA copy we should A/B test: "Estimate your per-request cost" vs "See latency at scale". Also want a line for product-led flows: "Try it now with free credits" -> direct to a benchmarking quickstart.

jamal: Data slices: I'll export quantized vs fp16 for the four models, plus simulated routing case (75% fast/25% high-quality) and compute cost-per-request. Expectable CSV ready by tomorrow noon.

maria: Excellent. A couple micro-asks: 1) keep charts readable in slide deck thumbnails (no tiny legends), 2) annotate one real-world use case (chatbot search vs summary) so viewers relate, 3) include one slide note about routing + SLA guardrails.

alex: Will do. Mockup will use big dots + label callouts. Using this chart config snippet for plotting:
```
{
  x: 'tokens_per_second',
  y: 'cost_per_1k_tokens',
  color: 'model_variant',
  scale_y: 'log',
  annotations: ['p95_latency_ms', 'recommended_route']
}
```

sam: Copy directions: keep paragraphs short. Lead with outcome: "Ship faster without breaking the budget." Then quick bullets: "what we measured, how to interpret, how to adopt."

olivia: I'll wire the landing routing flow in Figma after we have slides. Also adding a short demo CTA for enterprise that links to a capacity calculator.

maria: Great. Follow-ups: alex + olivia — please drop WIP in #design by EOD Tue. sam + jamal — copy + data by Tue noon. We'll sync Wed 10am to finalize webinar slide order. Thanks team :rocket:
